law: every flag here drifts at the SAME rarity — no one's is rarer than anyone else's
provenance: Written 2026-08-04 by Opus (Claude), truly claude-opus-5[1m], at KP's word: 'did we create any pride bubble collections? we have a few pride colors and color themes in our token set we could derive pride sets from, they are important.' Derived from cosmic's PRIDE_COLORS (21 tokens: the rainbow six, the Progress additions, trans, nonBinary, genderfluid, agender, pansexual, bisexual, asexual, lesbian). The ten flags are all COMMON on purpose: rarity in this game is how often a thing drifts past, and a flag's whole job is to be seen. The two that sit higher are not identities — they are what the flags are for.

collections.name: Inclusive Pride
collections.description: Colours held up on purpose — one flag that carries the others inside it. Every flag here drifts at the same rarity, because no one's is rarer than anyone else's.

bubbles.name: Rainbow
bubbles.description: Six stripes, and the first was sewn by hand. Every flag starts as somebody's fabric.

bubbles.name: Progress
bubbles.description: The chevron that moves, pointing in. A flag that cannot grow is a flag that stopped meaning it.

bubbles.name: Trans Banner
bubbles.description: Pink, blue, and white in the middle for everyone still arriving. Designed to read correctly upside down — there is no wrong way to fly it.

bubbles.name: Non-Binary
bubbles.description: Yellow for outside it, white for all of it, purple for both, black for none. Four answers where two were offered.

bubbles.name: Genderfluid
bubbles.description: It moves. Moving was never the same as being unsure.

bubbles.name: Agender
bubbles.description: Complete, and not a gap where something should be. Absence is an answer too.

bubbles.name: Pansexual
bubbles.description: Three stripes with nobody left standing outside them.

bubbles.name: Bisexual
bubbles.description: Two colors and the overlap between. The middle is not indecision — it is its own colour.

bubbles.name: Asexual
bubbles.description: Grey between the black and the white, where most true things actually live.

bubbles.name: Lesbian
bubbles.description: Sunset stripes. Orange for the ones who came first, pink for the ones who came after.

bubbles.name: Intersex
bubbles.description: A purple circle on yellow, unbroken on purpose. Whole exactly as it arrived — nothing about it was ever waiting to be corrected.

bubbles.name: Found Family
bubbles.description: The people who chose you back. Not a replacement for anything — an addition nobody can take.

bubbles.name: Still Here
bubbles.description: Against a fair amount of evidence. That is the whole achievement, and it is enormous.
